summary: Frontend-only regression on new Revenue Attribution + Stock Management + Report Builder features. Executed a full end-to-end Playwright flow using client-side sidebar navigation (state lives in React Context, so page.goto() full reloads reset all mutations). All 14 listed features work as spec'd: KPI math, blocked/available columns, order lifecycle transitions correctly update blocked counts and revenue KPIs, returns restock and refund correctly, lf-stock filter works, Analytics Report Builder handles all 4 report types, filters, column picker and CSV export. Zero console/page errors across all pages.

issues: When Blocked=0, cell shows '—' which is fine; when Blocked>0 it shows just a number (no visual badge/highlight). Task described a 'blocked=2 badge'. Current rendering is a plain right-aligned number. Minor cosmetic gap only — not a functional issue.

Consider useCallback deps or functional setListings that reads products via setProducts callback pattern.
Revenue KPI math (Confirmed − Refunded = Net) verified numerically: 50968 − 6824 = 44144 ✓, then after +14999 refund 63966 − 21823 = 42143 ✓.
lf-stock option values are 'all' | 'in_stock' | 'low' | 'out'. Documented for next agents (task text uses hyphenated names loosely).
Analytics 'low' stock filter produced 0 rows on current seed — reasonable given seed data but consider defining threshold or highlighting in UI so users know why.
